senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; עָמַר)tuft, spike, esp. ear of grain; (mostly collective) sheaves.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 7:4">Sabb. VII, 4</cite> <he>המוציא … ע׳ וכ׳</he> he who carries out ears (fit for fodder) as much as a lamb’s mouthful.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 1:17">Tosef. Dem. I, 17</cite>. Sifra K’doshim, Par. 1, ch. III leave for the poor <he>תלתן בע׳</he> fenugrec in the spikes; Y. Peah IV, beg. 18ᵃ.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 2:13">Tosef. Shebi. II, 13</cite> <he>פול המצרי שזרעו לע׳</he> Egyptian beans which one planted for the sake of the spikes (as fodder).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Batra 5:1:3">Y. B. Bath. V, beg. 15ᵃ</cite> <he>בשזרעו לע׳</he> (not <he>משזרען</he>) when he planted the fenugrec for the spikes, opp. <he>לזרע</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Sukkah 1:4">Tosef. Succ. I, 4</cite>, v. <cite ref="Q01488"><he>פְּקִיעַ</he> I</cite>; a. fr.
